radar.signal: Le modele d'embedding est une decision quasi irreversible : en changer = tout re-encoder

pieges.B: Independant du modele qui a indexe les documents
pieges.C: Un reglage separe, sans lien avec le choix du modele d'embedding
pieges.D: La precision ne prime pas toujours ; 3 % contre un stockage divise par quatre est un vrai arbitrage

explication: Les embeddings de deux modeles ne sont pas comparables : changer de modele impose de re-encoder les 400 000 documents. Les neuf heures sont le chiffre plante : elles donnent le cout d'une erreur, pas le cout de l'operation. Avec la strategie de chunking, c'est l'une des deux decisions irreversibles au debut d'un pipeline RAG.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A lending team must check, before any model is trained, whether its historical dataset favors one demographic group over another in the labels themselves. No model exists yet, and the team wants the check to run as a step in the data pipeline. Which metrics apply?

options.A: Post-training bias metrics computed from model predictions
options.B: Pre-training bias metrics such as class imbalance (CI) and difference in positive proportions in labels (DPL)
options.C: Feature attribution drift against a baseline
options.D: Equal opportunity difference, which compares true positive rates

radar.signal: Pas de modele -> metriques pre-entrainement (labels + groupes seulement)

pieges.A: Les metriques post-entrainement exigent des predictions
pieges.C: Concept de monitoring d'un modele deploye ; rien n'est deploye
pieges.D: Un taux de vrais positifs exige predictions et labels : c'est une metrique post-entrainement

explication: Les metriques pre-entrainement se calculent a partir des labels et de l'appartenance aux groupes seulement, donc comme une etape de pipeline avant l'entrainement. 'Aucun modele n'existe encore' est toute la question.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A team computes a customer's rolling spend average in a Spark job for training and reimplements the same calculation in the application's Java code for real-time inference. The two implementations were written by different people from the same specification, and production predictions differ from what offline testing predicted. Which TWO approaches address this? (Choose TWO.)

options.A: Lower the model's decision threshold
options.B: Retrain the model more frequently
options.C: Use an inference pipeline so that the same transformation container runs at training and at serving
options.D: Use a SageMaker Feature Store feature group that both training and inference read
options.E: Increase the size of the training dataset

declencheurs: Spark for training, Java for inference
radar.signal: Skew entrainement/inference -> supprimer la seconde implementation (Feature Store ou pipeline d'inference)

pieges.A: Le seuil ne corrige pas des valeurs de features differentes
pieges.B: Reentrainer reapprend la definition Spark ; le chemin de service calcule toujours autre chose
pieges.E: Plus de donnees ne reconcilie pas deux implementations

explication: Deux implementations d'une meme definition, c'est le skew entre entrainement et service. Les deux corrections structurelles suppriment la seconde implementation : une source de verite partagee (Feature Store) ou une seule implementation deployee (pipeline d'inference).
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A team plans to fine-tune a foundation model to produce support replies in the company's house format and tone. It has 60,000 historical tickets of mixed quality, including many replies that a supervisor later corrected. How much data should the team use?

options.A: Use all 60,000 tickets, because more data always improves fine-tuning
options.B: Use the corrected replies only as negative examples
options.C: Curate a few thousand high-quality, consistently formatted examples
options.D: Skip fine-tuning and put the house format in the system prompt permanently

radar.signal: Le fine-tuning apprend le motif montre : la coherence prime sur le volume

pieges.A: Un grand jeu incoherent apprend l'incoherence
pieges.B: Un jeu de fine-tuning standard est fait de demonstrations ; il n'y a pas de mecanisme d'exemples negatifs
pieges.D: Premiere etape legitime, mais la decision de fine-tuner est prise et format/ton est son cas d'usage

explication: 500 exemples excellents valent mieux que 5 000 bruites. 'Qualite mixte, avec des reponses corrigees ensuite' est le detail plante qui fait de 60 000 tickets un handicap plutot qu'un atout.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A team must train a language model whose parameters do not fit in the memory of a single GPU. It has a multi-GPU instance available. Training fails with an out-of-memory error at model initialization, before any batch is processed. What should the team use?

options.A: Data parallelism, splitting batches across GPUs
options.B: Gradient accumulation across steps
options.C: A smaller batch size
options.D: Model parallelism, splitting the model across GPUs

declencheurs: parameters do not fit on one GPU
radar.signal: Echec avant tout batch -> aucun levier lie au batch ; il faut partitionner le modele

pieges.A: Chaque GPU garde une copie complete : si une copie ne tient pas, aucune ne tient
pieges.B: Simule un grand batch avec peu de memoire, mais le modele lui-meme ne tient pas
pieges.C: Reduit la memoire d'activations ; l'echec survient avant le premier batch

explication: Le parallelisme de modele partitionne le modele entre GPU, si bien qu'aucun GPU ne porte tous les parametres (SMP v2 : parallelisme tensoriel ou pipeline, ou sharded data parallel facon FSDP). 'Echoue a l'initialisation, avant tout batch' elimine d'une phrase toutes les corrections liees au batch.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A team needs a model that answers questions about contracts averaging 80 pages, reading the whole document in one request. Some contracts include scanned signature pages and diagrams that must be interpreted. Latency tolerance is generous, and the workload runs in an AWS Region with limited model availability. What should drive the model selection?

options.A: Context window, modality support, and Regional availability
options.B: Parameter count, as a proxy for capability
options.C: Cost per output token
options.D: Fine-tuning support

radar.signal: Contraintes dures : longueur (fenetre de contexte), modalite, disponibilite regionale

pieges.B: Souvent non publie, et ne dit pas si un modele accepte 80 pages ou lit un schema
pieges.C: Les sorties sont courtes ; c'est la gestion de l'entree qui contraint
pieges.D: Rien ne demande de changer le comportement du modele

explication: Quatre-vingts pages fixent un plancher de fenetre de contexte, les pages scannees et schemas exigent une entree multimodale, et une disponibilite regionale limitee peut eliminer un modele d'emblee. La modalite et la Region eliminent le plus vite ; on arbitre ensuite cout et qualite.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A RAG evaluation shows faithfulness at 0.91 and answer correctness at 0.62, with high context relevance. Reviewers report that answers are well supported by the passages provided but frequently miss part of what was asked. Retrieval returns five chunks per query. What does this pattern indicate?

options.A: The generating model is hallucinating and should be replaced
options.B: Context coverage is the weakness: retrieval is missing part of the answer
options.C: The judge model is miscalibrated
options.D: The chunk size is too large, which dilutes relevance

declencheurs: miss part of what was asked
radar.signal: Fidelite haute + justesse basse = le modele a bien utilise un materiel incomplet

pieges.A: Une fidelite de 0,91 dit l'inverse : les reponses sont bien ancrees
pieges.C: Les relecteurs constatent la meme chose independamment
pieges.D: La pertinence est haute ; une dilution la ferait baisser

explication: Pertinence haute et couverture basse : ce qui revient est le bon materiel, mais pas en quantite suffisante. Leviers : plus de resultats (numberOfResults), chunks plus grands ou chunking hierarchique. Un job retrieve-only avec la metrique context coverage le confirme.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A team hosts four large language models on one SageMaker AI endpoint with inference components. Two of the models are called only during business hours and sit idle overnight, and the team wants to stop paying for them when unused. Requests that arrive while a component is scaled to zero must not fail. What should the team do?

options.A: Set MinInstanceCount to zero for those two components and accept the behavior
options.B: Delete the two components every night and recreate them every morning
options.C: Scale those two components to zero, and queue requests through asynchronous inference
options.D: Move the two models to a multi-model endpoint

radar.signal: Scale-to-zero fait echouer les requetes ; une file asynchrone les fait attendre

pieges.A: Les requetes arrivant a zero capacite echouent au lieu d'attendre : c'est interdit
pieges.B: Rituel fragile, et toute requete hors heures echoue
pieges.D: Un multi-model partage un conteneur et un framework, et garde une instance qui tourne

explication: Une requete qui arrive sur un composant a zero echoue (NoCapacityInvocationFailures). Avec une file asynchrone, elle attend : le reveil coute de la latence et non une erreur. 'Ne doit pas echouer' est la contrainte qui exclut le scale-to-zero nu.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A retailer's assistant has run on Amazon Bedrock on-demand for nine months. Usage is steady at about 40 million tokens a day with little variation, finance has approved a commitment, and the team wants guaranteed throughput ahead of a product launch. The assistant uses a base model with no customization. Which TWO statements should inform the decision? (Choose TWO.)

options.A: Provisioned Throughput applies only to custom models, so it cannot be used here
options.B: Nine months of steady usage provides a defensible baseline to size a commitment
options.C: Provisioned Throughput reserves capacity and is billed whether or not it is used
options.D: Custom models always require Provisioned Throughput, so it is mandatory here
options.E: Provisioned Throughput automatically reduces the per-token rate on all traffic

radar.signal: Le risque (capacite payee meme inutilisee) et la condition (usage mesure et stable)

pieges.A: Le PT existe pour les modeles de base comme pour les modeles custom
pieges.D: Fait autrefois vrai, aujourd'hui faux, et il s'agit d'un modele de base
pieges.E: Le PT reserve un debit ; il n'applique pas de remise a tout le trafic on-demand

explication: Le Provisioned Throughput se paie en continu : sur-dimensionner, c'est perdre de l'argent. Neuf mois d'usage stable mesure rendent l'engagement raisonnable plutot que speculatif. B est le distracteur le plus dangereux : un fait qui etait vrai.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: For each incoming insurance claim, a process must extract fields from the PDF, validate them against a policy database, calculate a settlement with a fixed formula, and email the claimant. The sequence never varies, and every branch is known in advance. An engineer proposes building the process as an autonomous agent with tools. How should the ML engineer respond?

options.A: Agree, but cap the agent at three steps to control cost
options.B: Agree, because agents handle document extraction better than workflows
options.C: Build it as an agent, but remove the email tool for safety
options.D: Build it as a workflow, because the sequence is known and an agent adds cost and unpredictability

radar.signal: Si on peut dessiner l'organigramme, on construit l'organigramme

pieges.A: Traite le symptome, et un plafond de trois pas casserait une sequence de quatre
pieges.B: L'extraction est faite par un outil ou un service dans les deux cas
pieges.C: Supprime l'etape qui termine le processus

explication: Une sequence connue et invariable demande de l'orchestration (Step Functions, par exemple), pas un modele qui decide quoi faire ensuite. Un agent ne se justifie que lorsque la suite d'etapes n'est pas connue a l'avance. Echelle : prompt, recuperation, outil, workflow, agent ; l'examen recompense le plus bas echelon qui marche.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: An upstream team changes a currency field from pounds to pence without telling anyone. A deployed pricing model starts producing implausible outputs within hours. Ground truth for pricing decisions arrives 60 days later. The team wants to be alerted on the day this kind of change happens. Which monitoring should the team rely on?

options.A: Data quality monitoring, comparing inputs against a baseline
options.B: Feature attribution drift monitoring
options.C: Model quality monitoring, comparing predictions against labels
options.D: Scheduled evaluation against a frozen test set

radar.signal: Delai des labels -> seul le monitoring sans labels detecte vite : data quality

pieges.B: Plus lent et indirect pour un changement d'unite
pieges.C: Exige la verite terrain, qui arrive 60 jours plus tard
pieges.D: Un jeu de test fige ne revele pas que les entrees en direct ont change

explication: Un decalage d'un facteur cent dans la distribution d'un champ numerique viole immediatement la baseline. La plupart des 'derives' sont en realite une tache amont cassee, ce qui se corrige bien plus vite qu'un reentrainement. Glue Data Quality en amont attraperait le probleme encore plus tot.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A production SageMaker AI endpoint serving a regulated model was reconfigured overnight to use a different model version. Nobody on the team remembers making the change. Compliance asks when the change was made, by which principal, and from where. CloudWatch shows the endpoint behaving normally after the change. Where should the team look?

options.A: The CloudWatch Logs of the endpoint container
options.B: AWS CloudTrail, for the UpdateEndpoint API call and its identity information
options.C: SageMaker Model Monitor data quality reports
options.D: The SageMaker Model Registry

declencheurs: when, by which principal, from where
radar.signal: 'Qui l'a fait' = CloudTrail

pieges.A: La sortie du conteneur dit ce que le modele a fait, pas qui a appele une API
pieges.C: Compare des entrees a une baseline, sans trace des changements de configuration
pieges.D: Enregistre versions et approbations, pas qui a modifie la configuration d'un endpoint

explication: CloudTrail enregistre les actions console et les appels d'API avec l'identite (utilisateur, role temporaire, service), l'heure et l'adresse source. CloudWatch repond a ce que le systeme a fait ; CloudTrail repond a qui a agi dessus.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A data team runs about forty unpredictable ad hoc exploratory queries a week over 200 TB of event data in Amazon S3. It also needs sub-second dashboard queries over a curated 400 GB subset, refreshed nightly, for 300 business users. The team wants to minimize total cost and operational effort. What should the team build?

options.A: Amazon EMR with Presto for both workloads
options.B: Amazon Athena for both workloads
options.C: Amazon Athena over S3 for exploration, and Amazon Redshift for the curated dashboard subset
options.D: Amazon Redshift for both workloads

radar.signal: Deux charges de profils opposes -> deux services

pieges.A: Le plus capable et le plus lourd a operer, alors que l'effort operationnel doit etre minimal
pieges.B: Bon pour l'exploration, pas pour des tableaux de bord concurrents sous la seconde
pieges.D: Charger 200 To pour quarante requetes par semaine : enorme cout pour une faible utilisation

explication: La facturation a la requete d'Athena convient a une exploration sporadique sur S3 ; un entrepot convient a des requetes petites, chaudes et concurrentes. Le piege est de supposer qu'un seul service doit servir les deux charges.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A data scientist encodes a merchant identifier with 90,000 distinct values by replacing each merchant with the mean fraud rate observed for that merchant across the full dataset. Some merchants appear only two or three times. Cross-validated performance is excellent, but production performance is poor. What is the problem?

options.A: One-hot encoding should have been used for 90,000 categories
options.B: 90,000 categories is too many for any encoding scheme
options.C: The merchant identifier has no predictive value and should be dropped
options.D: Target encoding computed on the full dataset leaks the label, especially for rare categories

radar.signal: Target encoding avant le split / sans lissage = fuite du label

pieges.A: Un one-hot sur 90 000 valeurs produit un espace inutilisable ; le target encoding est la bonne famille
pieges.B: Hashing, embeddings ou target encoding correctement ajuste gerent la haute cardinalite
pieges.C: L'identite du marchand est generalement tres predictive ; c'est l'encodage qui est contamine

explication: La valeur encodee contient le label : pour un marchand vu trois fois, elle revele presque le resultat de la ligne elle-meme. Il faut calculer l'encodage sur le train uniquement (idealement out-of-fold) et lisser les categories rares vers la moyenne globale.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A new team in a new AWS account must label 25,000 images for a classification project within six weeks. Its architecture document, written eighteen months ago, specifies SageMaker Ground Truth with a private workforce, but the team cannot create a labeling job. What should the revised plan be?

options.A: Use a third-party labeling service or an in-house labeling workflow, because Ground Truth is closed to new customers
options.B: Attach the Ground Truth managed policy to the execution role
options.C: Switch the project to unsupervised learning to avoid labeling
options.D: Request a service quota increase for labeling jobs

radar.signal: Nouveau compte + document ancien = service en maintenance, ferme aux nouveaux clients

pieges.B: Aucune politique ne donne acces a un service ferme au compte
pieges.C: Change le probleme pour l'adapter a l'outil : la classification exige des labels
pieges.D: Un quota plafonne l'usage ; il n'ouvre pas un service ferme

explication: Ground Truth est passe en maintenance le 30 juillet 2026 et est ferme aux nouveaux clients, ce qu'un document vieux de dix-huit mois ignore. AWS oriente vers Bedrock Data Automation, un service d'etiquetage tiers ou un workflow interne. A l'examen, Ground Truth reste la reponse a 'quel service etiquette un jeu de donnees'.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A knowledge base must cover 30,000 engineering drawings and specification documents. About 40% of the useful content is inside tables and annotated diagrams rather than prose, and the current text-only extraction pipeline loses most of it. Answers must cite the source document and page. What should the team use for ingestion?

options.A: Larger chunks, so that tables are not split across boundaries
options.B: Amazon Bedrock Data Automation for multimodal parsing during ingestion
options.C: Amazon Textract OCR only, followed by standard chunking
options.D: A higher numberOfResults at query time

radar.signal: L'echec est a l'extraction -> parsing multimodal (Bedrock Data Automation)

pieges.A: Aide un tableau coupe, pas un contenu jamais extrait
pieges.C: L'OCR recupere du texte mais n'interprete pas un schema annote
pieges.D: Recupere davantage de ce qui est indexe ; 40 % n'ont jamais ete indexes

explication: BDA transforme tableaux et schemas en texte indexable (texte en ordre de lecture, legendes de tableaux et figures). Agrandir les chunks ou augmenter numberOfResults regle la recuperation sur un contenu qui n'a jamais ete capture : l'echec est en amont.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A retrieval system uses 300-token chunks and returns the top five. Users ask questions whose answers span several pages of a procedure. Evaluation shows that context coverage is the weakest metric while context relevance is high. The generating model has a large context window, cost is not a constraint, and latency tolerance is generous. Which TWO changes should the team try? (Choose TWO.)

options.A: Increase the chunk size so that each chunk holds more of a procedure
options.B: Reduce the chunk size to 150 tokens
options.C: Increase numberOfResults above five
options.D: Enable implicit filtering so that procedures are detected automatically
options.E: Switch from semantic search to keyword-only search

radar.signal: Bon materiel, pas assez -> plus de passages et des passages plus grands

pieges.B: Des chunks plus petits contiennent moins de chaque procedure et aggravent la couverture
pieges.D: Le filtrage implicite restreint les resultats, il n'en ajoute pas
pieges.E: La pertinence est deja elevee ; le mot-cle seul la ferait probablement baisser

explication: Couverture basse avec pertinence haute signifie 'le bon materiel, mais pas assez'. Les deux bonnes reponses augmentent la quantite de materiel qui atteint le modele, ce que permettent la grande fenetre de contexte et l'absence de contrainte de cout. Le chunking hierarchique serait une autre piste.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A European bank is building a document assistant on Amazon Bedrock. Legal requires that customer documents never leave the EU, that no data crosses Regional boundaries during inference, and that the strongest available prompt-attack filtering be applied. The Standard guardrail tier requires opting in to cross-Region inference. How should the bank proceed?

options.A: Enable the Standard tier, because stronger safety outranks residency
options.B: Abandon guardrails, because the required tier is unavailable
options.C: Use the Classic tier within the EU Region, and compensate with tighter content filters and application controls
options.D: Enable the Standard tier and document the cross-Region data flow as an accepted risk

radar.signal: Une exigence legale est une contrainte, pas une priorite : on concoit a l'interieur

pieges.A: Une exigence de residence ne s'echange pas contre une preference technique
pieges.B: Le tier Classic reste disponible et utile
pieges.D: Documenter une violation d'exigence legale ne la rend pas acceptable

explication: Le tier Standard des guardrails gere mieux les fautes de frappe, couvre jusqu'a 60 langues et distingue jailbreak et injection, mais exige l'opt-in au cross-Region inference. Quand la residence l'interdit, on reste en Classic dans la Region et on renforce le reste : filtres plus stricts, controles applicatifs.
domain: Data Preparation for ML and AI

question: A team has a well-structured tabular dataset with 400,000 rows and 60 features for churn prediction. Its data scientist proposes a six-week program to build and tune a custom neural network. There is no existing baseline, and the business wants a first result within two weeks. How should the ML engineer respond?

options.A: Approve the neural network, because deep learning outperforms tree models on large datasets
options.B: Reduce the feature count to speed up the custom build
options.C: Use a foundation model with the tabular data in the prompt
options.D: Run SageMaker Autopilot first to establish a baseline, then decide whether custom work is justified

radar.signal: Pas de baseline + delai court -> Autopilot d'abord

pieges.A: Faux sur du tabulaire structure, ou le gradient boosting est generalement meilleur et moins cher
pieges.B: 60 features est modeste ; les couper affaiblit le modele sans regler le calendrier
pieges.C: Mauvais outil pour une classification de 400 000 lignes, et bien plus cher par prediction

explication: Autopilot explore feature engineering, algorithmes et hyperparametres, classe les candidats et genere des notebooks : un resultat en deux semaines, et une barre a battre pour le projet de six semaines. Sans baseline, personne ne pourrait dire si la construction sur mesure en valait la peine.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A team runs long training jobs with managed Spot training and checkpoints every epoch. It also uses in-training early stopping that halts when validation loss has not improved for three epochs. Since Spot was enabled, some jobs stop much earlier than expected and produce weaker models. What is the likely interaction?

options.A: The early-stopping state must be saved and restored with the checkpoint, or it can halt training prematurely after a resume
options.B: Early stopping is incompatible with managed Spot training
options.C: Spot interruptions corrupt checkpoints, so training resumes from bad weights
options.D: Spot instances have less memory, so fewer epochs complete

radar.signal: Un checkpoint doit sauver tout l'etat dont la boucle depend, pas seulement les poids

pieges.B: Elles ne sont pas incompatibles : elles interagissent
pieges.C: SageMaker AI reprend depuis le dernier checkpoint complet ; la corruption n'est pas le symptome
pieges.D: Spot, c'est le meme materiel a un autre prix

explication: L'early stopping garde un etat : la meilleure perte et le nombre d'epoques sans amelioration. Un checkpoint qui sauve les poids sans cet etat repart avec un compteur reinitialise ou trompeur, et la boucle se comporte differemment apres un redemarrage.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A model flags transactions for manual review. A review costs about 4 GBP, and a missed fraud costs about 900 GBP on average. Review capacity is 1,200 cases a day, and the model currently flags 400 a day at the proposed threshold. The team has a precision-recall curve and must choose an operating threshold. What should the team do?

options.A: Choose the threshold that maximizes F1 as a balanced default
options.B: Lower the threshold to catch more fraud, because capacity allows it and a miss costs 225 times a review
options.C: Use the default threshold of 0.5
options.D: Raise the threshold to improve precision and reduce review cost

radar.signal: Couts asymetriques + capacite disponible -> baisser le seuil

pieges.A: F1 pondere precision et recall a egalite, or les couts sont tres inegaux
pieges.C: 0,5 est un defaut, pas une valeur calibree, et ignore les couts fournis
pieges.D: Economise 4 GBP au risque d'en perdre 900 : l'arithmetique va dans le mauvais sens

explication: Tous les chiffres sont fournis : un ratio de 225 pour 1 entre les deux erreurs et 800 places de revue libres par jour. On choisit le seuil qui minimise le cout attendu (matrice de couts), sur des donnees de validation a la vraie distribution, sans reentrainer.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A document assistant on Amazon Bedrock sends a 6,000-token policy manual and a 200-token system prompt at the start of every request, followed by a short user question. It handles 90,000 requests a day, and input token cost now dominates the bill. The manual changes about once a month, and answers are short. What is the MOST effective change?

options.A: Move the manual into a knowledge base and retrieve only relevant sections
options.B: Switch to a cheaper model for all traffic
options.C: Enable prompt caching on the stable prefix, and consider retrieval as a later step
options.D: Reduce maxTokens to shorten the answers

radar.signal: Gros prefixe identique en tete de chaque requete -> prompt caching

pieges.A: Bonne idee mais plus lourde (index, sync, evaluation) ; le cache obtient l'essentiel sans effort
pieges.B: Baisse le tarif sans baisser le volume, et change la qualite de toutes les reponses
pieges.D: Les reponses sont deja courtes ; c'est l'entree qui domine

explication: Le prompt caching reutilise un prefixe repete, avec jusqu'a 90 % de remise sur les tokens en cache et une latence reduite. Le manuel est identique sur chaque requete et deja en tete du prompt : c'est la forme ideale pour le cache. La recuperation peut venir ensuite si le manuel grossit.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A regulator asks a bank to document a deployed credit model: its intended use, the data it was trained on, its performance across demographic subgroups, its known limitations, and who approved it for production. The model is in the SageMaker Model Registry, and the training code is in a repository. What should the bank produce?

options.A: The training job's CloudWatch logs and hyperparameters
options.B: A SHAP summary plot for the most recent 1,000 predictions
options.C: The pipeline definition from the repository
options.D: A SageMaker model card, with the registry's approval record and the subgroup evaluation attached

declencheurs: intended use, data, subgroup performance, limitations, approver
radar.signal: Un seul artefact concu pour ces cinq champs -> model card + registre

pieges.A: Montre comment le modele a ete entraine, rien sur l'usage prevu ou l'approbation
pieges.B: Explique ce sur quoi le modele s'appuie : un element, pas la reponse aux cinq questions
pieges.C: Montre comment le modele est construit, pas l'usage, les performances par sous-groupe ni l'approbation

explication: Une model card documente usage prevu, niveau de risque, details d'entrainement et resultats d'evaluation ; elle s'attache a une version du Model Registry, peut inclure rapports de biais et d'explicabilite, et s'exporte en PDF. Le registre fournit l'enregistrement d'approbation.
domain: ML Model and FM Development

question: A CPU-based recommendation model serves 2,000 requests per second from a fleet of x86 instances. Inference is a straightforward matrix operation with no framework-specific custom kernels. The team wants better price-performance and has a containerized build pipeline. Latency requirements are unchanged, and accuracy must not move. What should the team try FIRST?

options.A: Rebuild the container for Arm64 and move to AWS Graviton instances
options.B: Move to GPU instances
options.C: Compile the model with the SageMaker AI inference optimization toolkit
options.D: Quantize the model to INT8

radar.signal: Meilleur prix/performance CPU sans toucher au modele -> Graviton

pieges.B: Un GPU pour de petites requetes CPU sera sous-utilise et plus cher
pieges.C: Neutre en precision et utile, mais plus de travail et ne baisse pas le tarif horaire
pieges.D: La quantification peut deplacer la precision, ce qui est interdit

explication: Graviton ameliore le rapport prix/performance pour l'inference CPU, sans modifier le modele ni ses sorties. Le pipeline conteneurise rend la reconstruction Arm64 peu couteuse. 'La precision ne doit pas bouger' elimine immediatement la quantification.
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A compliance knowledge base on Amazon Bedrock indexes policy documents, and its ingestion job runs on the first day of each month. A policy was withdrawn on Monday and deleted from the source S3 bucket. On Wednesday, a user received an answer that cited the withdrawn policy as current. What is the problem, and what should change?

options.A: Chunk overlap caused duplication; reduce the overlap percentage
options.B: The index keeps the deleted document until the next sync; sync more frequently and alarm on sync recency
options.C: The user's query was ambiguous; add query rewriting
options.D: The model hallucinated the policy; enable contextual grounding checks

radar.signal: Supprimer a la source ne retire rien de l'index avant la prochaine synchronisation

pieges.A: Le recouvrement concerne le decoupage, pas la presence de documents supprimes
pieges.C: La requete a trouve exactement le document demande ; il n'aurait plus du etre la
pieges.D: Le modele etait fidele a ce qu'il a recupere : le passage contenait vraiment la politique retiree

explication: Un job d'ingestion synchronise la data source : documents modifies re-encodes, documents supprimes retires de l'index. Un document supprime mais non synchronise reste recuperable, ce qui est un risque de divulgation. La frequence de sync est une decision de gouvernance : quelle anciennete une reponse peut-elle avoir avant d'etre fausse ?
domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows

question: A benefits assistant must never state that a claimant qualifies for a payment when the documented rules say otherwise. Eligibility depends on age bands, contribution history, and residency duration, all written as formal criteria. When a response is rejected, the team needs an explanation of which rule it violated for the audit trail. Which Amazon Bedrock Guardrails safeguard fits?

options.A: Contextual grounding checks, with the rules document as the grounding source
options.B: Denied topics that cover eligibility statements
options.C: Automated Reasoning checks, with the eligibility rules authored as a policy
options.D: Content filters at HIGH strength on the output

radar.signal: Regles formelles + explication exigee -> Automated Reasoning checks

pieges.A: Notation probabiliste : une affirmation fausse redigee comme la source peut sembler soutenue, sans dire quelle regle est violee
pieges.B: Empecherait l'assistant de parler d'eligibilite, sa raison d'etre
pieges.D: Une affirmation d'eligibilite fausse est incorrecte, pas nocive : elle passe tous les filtres

explication: Automated Reasoning verifie les affirmations par logique formelle contre une politique que l'on redige une fois ; c'est la seule garde qui peut prouver qu'une affirmation est fausse et expliquer pourquoi. Le contextual grounding note la plausibilite par rapport a une source fournie a chaque requete. Deux signaux ici : des regles vraiment formelles, et une explication plutot qu'un score.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

question: A retraining pipeline runs every week and registers a new model whenever training accuracy exceeds 0.90. Every run passes, yet production accuracy has fallen for four consecutive months. The team proposes raising the threshold to 0.95. Which TWO changes should the ML engineer recommend? (Choose TWO.)

options.A: Retrain daily instead of weekly, keeping the same gate
options.B: Raise the training accuracy threshold to 0.95 as proposed
options.C: Trigger retraining on drift detection or new data instead of a weekly schedule
options.D: Gate registration on a metric computed on a held-out evaluation set, not on training accuracy
options.E: Remove the ConditionStep, because it is not preventing anything

radar.signal: Deux defauts : une porte qui mesure la memorisation, et un declencheur sans lien avec la realite

pieges.A: Plus de runs inutiles, avec une porte toujours cassee
pieges.B: Un modele sur-ajuste franchit 0,95 aussi facilement que 0,90
pieges.E: Il faut rendre la seule porte de qualite pertinente, pas la supprimer

explication: L'accuracy d'entrainement mesure la memorisation : tout modele passe. Une metrique sur un jeu tenu a part est la seule version de la porte qui puisse echouer. Un calendrier hebdomadaire reentraine quand rien n'a change et rate la degradation entre deux runs : on declenche sur derive (alarme vers EventBridge) ou sur l'arrivee de donnees.
domain: Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions
